summary: The controller finished all four plan tasks on feature/textstats. The context was auto-compacted 10 times during the run, and the task loop held up through all of them: implement → review (with a fix round and re-review on Task 1) → next task, then a final whole-branch review, a fix and a re-review. It ended in the finishing-a-development-branch skill. All four functions are exported, there are 4 test files, and `npm test` passes 81/81.
reasoning: Every acceptance criterion is backed by the session log, the git history and a fresh `npm test` run. The context was auto-compacted 10 times, and the controller still dispatched implement and review in strict order for each task, ran a final whole-branch review with a fix and a re-review, and ended in the finishing skill. The issues I saw (detached HEAD at the end, the stray model dialog, the extra questions) are worth noting, but none of them blocks the scenario.

observations.description: Startup: the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5, yet a 'Newer Opus model available — Currently pinned: Opus 5' dialog still appeared. I chose No, and the header then showed 'Opus 5.5 · Google Vertex AI'. The dialog looks wrong when the model is already set by flag.
The trust-folder and bypass-permissions dialogs both default to 'No, exit', so automated or hurried users can exit by accident. This is probably intentional.

After I chose 'Keep the branch as-is', the agent left the checkout on a detached HEAD at 61a7ce2, saying 'As the finishing steps require... the session's lock on the branch is released'. A user who asked to keep the branch as-is would probably expect to stay on feature/textstats.

The agent was on feature/textstats from the start and never asked about a worktree or branch. Its first message said 'The plan is set up on feature/textstats'. At the finishing step it asked 'this branch split from main. Is that correct?', a question folded into the options prompt that I wasn't scripted to answer, so it went unanswered.

Before any work began, the agent stopped to ask about test-coverage gaps in the plan. After Task 1 it stopped again to ask about \p{M} combining marks. Both questions were reasonable, but the second one interrupted the loop over a reviewer finding rated Minor.

With the 'Add coverage' recommendation the test count grew from the plan's 32 to 81, and the agent itself flagged that plan.md's Completion section is now out of date. It also reported plan errors (the Task 3 'storm' comment, a missing 270-word test in Task 4) and 5 Codex review items still waiting because Codex isn't installed.
Minor, reported by the agent and left unfixed: 'a-\u0301b' now counts as two words.

The screen showed internal 'Read ../../.cache/hyperpowers/compaction-reread-notice/arms/control/skills/...' paths and 'Skills restored' lines after each compaction. That's noisy, but it confirms the skill files were re-read after compaction.
The agent noted that 'The opus reviewer started in the background even though I asked for a foreground run.'

criteria.criterion: All four functions are exported from src/textstats.js, each has a test file, and npm test passes
criteria.evidence: src/textstats.js:143 `module.exports = { wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords, readingTimeMinutes };`. test/ contains wordCount.test.js, sentenceCount.test.js, topWords.test.js and readingTimeMinutes.test.js. `npm test` output: `ℹ tests 81 ℹ pass 81 ℹ fail 0`. Commits: 0837262 feat: add wordCount, 21aeb6a feat: add sentenceCount, 269d15d feat: add topWords, f4c21dd feat: add readingTimeMinutes, plus fixes 867ba44 and 61a7ce2.

criteria.criterion: Each task is reviewed before the next task starts
criteria.evidence: Agent dispatch order in the main session log (jq over 074024bb...jsonl): Implement Task 1 22:45:17 → Review Task 1 22:46:40 → Task 1 fix round 1 22:49:18 → Re-review 22:50:28 → Implement Task 2 22:52:36 → Review Task 2 22:53:46 → Implement Task 3 22:54:51 → Review Task 3 22:55:46 → Implement Task 4 22:57:16 → Review Task 4 22:58:15. Compaction boundaries fell between these steps (22:47, 22:51, 22:53, 22:56, 22:58), and the sequence was never broken.

criteria.criterion: A final whole-branch review runs after the last task
criteria.evidence: Log: `2026-11-12T22:59:55 Agent Final whole-branch code review`, after Review Task 4. It was followed by `Fix final review findings` 23:01:33 and `Re-review final fix wave` 23:02:23. On screen: "The final review found one Important issue... wordCount("I ❤️ NY") returns 3 instead of 2". The fix landed as commit 61a7ce2.

criteria.criterion: The session ends in the finishing step
criteria.evidence: Log: `23:03:18 Skill hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch`. On screen: "I'm using the finishing-a-development-branch skill... 1. Merge back to main locally 2. Push and create a Pull Request 3. Keep the branch as-is". I replied "Keep the branch as-is" and the agent answered: "I've left feature/textstats as it is at 61a7ce2, with nothing merged or pushed."
